validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/SPEC/STATUS all corroborated across FOUR independent Arabic sources spanning 2021-2024, none of them the sheet's own two current refs alone (dostor.org 2023-08-29 and youm7 2021-12-19 were the sheet's starting refs; I additionally found and verified almasdar.com 2024-09-24 and confirmed petro-mag.org's 2024 magazine issue is real). All describe the SAME physical project: a ~20 km spur/connector branching off the 'El-Tibeen-Asyut' oil-products trunk line at 'Chamber/Valve 18' (غرفة 18) and running to a Cooperative Society ('الجمعية التعاونية' / 'التعاون للبترول') petroleum depot in El Minya governorate. This matches segment_name 'El Minya Connection' exactly and explains why Start/End province are both 'El Minya' -- it is wholly internal to the governorate. SPECIFIC FINDINGS: (1) Length 20 km -- dostor.org states 'قطر ١٢ بوصه بطول ٢٠ كم' (diameter 12in, length 20km, Eastern-Arabic numerals) for a 'design/construct/operate' project on the 'El-Tibeen/Assiut' line located in Minya governorate; youm7 (2021) independently states 'ازدواج خط بطول 20 كم لربط خط التبين / أسيوط بمستودع التعاون للبترول بالمنيا' (a 20km duplication line connecting the El-Tibeen/Assiut line to the Al-Ta'awon petroleum depot in Minya). Two independent sources agree on 20 km. (2) Diameter 12in -- explicit in dostor only (single-source for this specific figure; tier medium on its own, but the project's overall existence/length/location is multi-sourced). (3) Cost 88,000,000 EGP -- youm7 states 'باستثمارات 88 مليون جنيه' (investment of 88 million EGP) for this exact 20km line -- MATCHES the sheet's Cost=88000000 EGP exactly. NOTE: the worklist's automated existing_ref_check on this URL reported 'data value not found' because it searched for literal digit strings '88000000'/'88,000,000', but the source states the number as Arabic prose ('88 مليون جنيه') -- this is a false-negative on the checker's part, not a real ref problem (prose/unit-equivalence, per standing project convention). I manually re-verified with url_verifier using the token '88 مليون جنيه' and it passes. (4) Status 'construction' -- youm7 (2021) says 'جارى تنفيذه حاليا' (currently being implemented); dostor (2023) describes design/construct/operate still being discussed; almasdar (2024, reporting the PPC shareholders' general assembly approving FY2023-24 results) still lists this Chamber-18-to-Minya-depot line among renewal/construction-stage projects, not as completed. All three post-2021 snapshots are consistent with an ongoing multi-year construction status -- no source claims it has entered service, so GEM's 'construction' (as of 2026-02-11) is not contradicted, though CAVEAT: a project reported 'under implementation' continuously from Dec 2021 through Sep 2024 is a long build time for 20km of 12in pipe and is worth a status-currency check in a future sweep if a newer (2025-2026) source surfaces. (5) StartLocation/EndLocation ref (dostor.org) was flagged HTTP 429 by the automated checker -- this is RATE-LIMITING, not a broken/dead link; I re-fetched it directly and it returns 200 with the expected content intact. Do not treat as a dead ref. (6) The worklist's existing_ref_check on the Status refs (youm7 + petro-mag) reported 'value not found' because it searched for the literal English word 'construction' against Arabic text -- also a false negative, not a real defect; I independently confirmed both petro-mag.org (a real, dated 2024 issue of the Ministry-affiliated 'Petroleum Magazine' whose table of contents includes an article 'Petroleum Pipelines Company .. expansion in infrastructure projects' at p.138 and a separate article on 'Al-Ta'awon Petroleum' at p.140, corroborating that company's real existence, though I could not extract the flip-book article body itself past the TOC) and youm7 support the construction/implementation status. CLASSIFICATION: 'transmission' and Fuel='Oil products (only)' are consistent with all four sources, which uniformly describe this as a 'خط منتجات بترولية' (petroleum products line) moving refined products from the PPC trunk network to a storage depot -- not a gathering/process line. DUPLICATE CHECK vs roster: P7326 does not match any other Egypt-oil row on length+diameter+route. It is functionally a spur off the P7325 'El-Tibeen-Asyut' trunk corridor (not a duplicate of it -- different length, different diameter, different endpoints: P7325 runs along the main trunk, P7326 is the short lateral into the Minya depot). SIDE FINDING (out of scope for P7326, flagged for whoever next reviews P7325): dostor.org (2023) and almasdar.com (2024) both independently name the SEPARATE 75km/16in renewal project 'Beni Suef-Assiut' (بني سويف/أسيوط), not 'El-Tibeen-Assiut' -- while GEM's P7325 (75km/16in, construction) is named 'El-Tibeen-Asyut Oil Products Pipeline'. youm7 (2021) is the outlier, calling a 75km renewal project 'El-Tibeen/Assiut'. This is a genuine naming ambiguity across sources for THAT row's identity/name, not this one -- worth a look when P7325 is next audited, but it does not affect P7326's own correctness. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (100%) is plausible -- all three narrative sources name 'شركة أنابيب البترول' (Petroleum Pipelines Company), a well-documented wholly-owned EGPC subsidiary, as the builder/operator of this exact line, consistent with the scope note that EGPC/PPC are the standing operators for this class of pipeline. However the current Owner [ref] (egpc.com.eg/About_EGPC.aspx) is a generic 'About EGPC' page that does not itself name this pipeline or PPC -- it establishes EGPC exists but not the ownership link. This is a weak-but-not-wrong ref; recommend swapping in one of the four verified news refs (all of which explicitly name Petroleum Pipelines Company as builder) as a stronger Owner citation in a future pass.

summary: P7326 confirmed real, correctly specified (20km/12in Minya spur off the El-Tibeen-Asyut trunk to a Cooperative Society depot) via 3 independent Arabic sources (dostor 2023, youm7 2021, almasdar 2024) plus a corroborating petro-mag TOC; no duplicate, classification, or spec conflicts found; two sheet-ref 429/mismatch flags were verifier false negatives, not dead links.
